# Nicolas Heaton, Hairdresser in Malmesbury

> Independent hairdresser in Malmesbury, Wiltshire, established 2002. Cutting, colour and styling by appointment. Call 01666 822158.

Nicolas Heaton has cut hair in Malmesbury since 2002. The salon is at 16 Griffin Alley. Every appointment starts with a consultation, and appointments are booked by phone. Colour is Goldwell; care and styling products are KMS.
